g.text: DCS / SIS / BMS / F&G - PURDUE LEVELS & IEC 62443 ZONES
NTP / PTP to L2, L1, SIS
DCS CONTROL NETWORK A / B (redundant, IEC 62439 ring) - CCR SWITCHES
2 x 24-core SM fibre, diverse routes CCR (OSBL) <-> FAR-100 (assumed ~ 800 m)
FAR-100: pressurised, blast-assessed, x 45-65 / y 5-17 m (layout.json)
X-101..X-104 chemical injection PLCs, AH-101 analysers,
K-102 VSD, MCC IEDs (SS-100) - Modbus TCP / IEC 61850
1 ms SOE on SIS / BMS trips,
HART pass-through on DCS AI/AO cards
SIS -> MCC trip relays (XY), F&G -> SIS
SYSTEM CABINETS + MARSHALLING CABINETS (FAR-100): DCS MC-*, SIS SMC-*, F&G FMC-*; IS barriers / isolators - UNIT TOTAL 860 I/O USED / 1320 INSTALLED
DCS: AI 197 AO 82 DI 130 DO 129 -> 538 used / 792 installed
SIS: AI 6 AO 0 DI 15 DO 16 -> 37 used / 80 installed
BMS: AI 48 AO 0 DI 36 DO 7 -> 91 used / 176 installed
F&G: AI 135 AO 0 DI 37 DO 22 -> 194 used / 272 installed
Spare: >= 20 % installed spare per card type (cards filled to <= 80 %) + 10 % space for future cards.
4-20 mA HART, Ex ia / Ex d
IR gas, IR3 flame, H2S, MCPs,
SS-100 SUBSTATION: MCC-101A/B, desalter transformer feeders (XY-1007/1008), UPS-101A/B, battery room
UPS: 2 x 100 % dual-bus (UPS-101A -> UDB-101A, UPS-101B -> UDB-101B), each with own battery, static bypass and external maintenance bypass
100 kVA each, 30 min autonomy, output 208Y/120 V 3-ph, 120 V 1-ph distribution, 60 Hz
UPS-DCS: 22 kVA (A UDB-101A 11 kVA + B UDB-101B 11 kVA) - Distributed control system (controllers, I/O, servers, HMI
UPS-SIS: 14 kVA (A UDB-101A 7 kVA + B UDB-101B 7 kVA) - Safety instrumented system incl. H-101/H-201 BMS, ESD sole
UPS-FGS: 6 kVA (A UDB-101A 3 kVA + B UDB-101B 3 kVA) - Fire & gas system incl. detectors/beacons
UPS-TEL: 8 kVA (A UDB-101A 4 kVA + B UDB-101B 4 kVA) - Telecom: PAGA, CCTV, LAN/fibre, radio
UPS-ANZ: 6 kVA (A UDB-101A 3 kVA + B UDB-101B 3 kVA) - Process analysers (AH-101)
UPS-MISC: 4 kVA (A UDB-101A 2 kVA + B UDB-101B 2 kVA) - Misc. instrument panels, MCC/IED networking, metering
Each system cabinet / console has dual PSUs fed from UDB-101A and UDB-101B (no single point of failure).
Historian replica read-only (PI-to-PI), patch/AV distribution, no inbound to L3
Historian push L3->DMZ only; remote access via jump host + MFA, session recorded
OPC UA (APC SP write, historian read), AMS HART pass-through, NTP; whitelisted
Read-only SIS -> DCS status/first-out via SIL-rated gateway; no DCS writes (bypass/reset by hardwired keyswitch)
Read-only F&G -> DCS mimic; F&G executive actions hardwired / SIS
Modbus TCP / IEC 61850 (MCC IEDs, packages X-101..104, AH-101) via industrial firewall
DCS: 3 redundant controller pairs (CDU-1, CDU-2, VDU) with redundant I/O comms and power; controller load <= 60 % CPU at FEED.
SIS: one SIL 3-capable logic solver (TMR or 2oo4D), physically and logically separate from the DCS (IEC 61511 cl. 11.2); BMS H-101/H-201 configured as
F&G: dedicated SIL 2 system; confirmed fire / gas executive actions per C&E CFU-000-IC-CE-001.
Time synchronisation: GPS master clock (L3) - NTP / PTP to servers, controllers, SIS SOE (1 ms).
Cyber: IEC 62443-3-2 risk assessment at detailed design; zones / conduits as shown; no direct L4 to L2 traffic; USB lock-down; whitelisting on EWS.
